brief: Reduce the permissible load by 8 percent of rating because one of three cooling fans is seized, and apply the additional ambient and sustained-event de-ratings required by MG-021. Run the remaining cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop the stages out, as instructed in MG-025. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, following MG-021.
